name: Aman
description: Named in Tobit's deathbed words as the one who brought up Achiacharus but handled him treacherously, bringing him out of light into darkness, and who himself fell into the snare he set and perished; distinct from Haman the Agagite of the book of Esther, a different story and era

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Aman, who ensnared Achiacharus
cases.charge: Treachery against the man who brought him up
cases.preview: Achiacharus was Tobit’s brother’s son, cupbearer, keeper of the signet, steward and overseer of the accounts under the king at Nineveh, and it was he who interceded for Tobit and brought him home,…
